itens.titulo: Bitmine Buys Another 8,573 ETH, Pushes Ethereum Holdings Past $13.7B
itens.descricao: Bitmine Buys Another 8,573 ETH, Pushes Ethereum Holdings Past $13.7B Yahoo Finance
trechos: Bitmine Immersion Technologies (NYSE: $BMNR) has increased its Ethereum (CRYPTO: $ETH) holdings to more than 6 million ETH, bringing its position to 4.9% of the cryptocurrency's total supply.
The company acquired 8,573 ETH over the past week, bringing its total holdings to 6,060,506 ETH, worth approximately $13.7 billion at a price of $2,261 per token as of Nov.
1, according to a Monday announcement.
Bitmine has staked 5,227,037 ETH, valued at roughly $11.8 billion, representing about 86% of its Ethereum holdings.
The company estimates that its staked ETH generates annualized revenue of $358 million.
That figure could rise to $415 million if the entire position were staked, based on its current yield.
It also holds $498 million in cash and marketable securities, bringing its combined crypto and other investments to approximately $14.5 billion.

The announcement also addressed the recent $6.3 billion Binance hack, with chairman Tom Lee arguing that the market's reaction suggests the crypto industry has become more resilient to major security incidents.

itens.titulo: Strive Buys 124 Bitcoin, Moves Closer to Overtaking Metaplanet
itens.descricao: Strive Buys 124 Bitcoin, Moves Closer to Overtaking Metaplanet Yahoo Finance
trechos: Bitcoin (CRYPTO: $BTC) treasury company Strive (Nasdaq: $ASST) added 124 BTC to its holdings last week, bringing its total stash to 43,124 BTC as it moves closer to becoming the second-largest publicly traded corporate Bitcoin holder.

The company purchased the coins between October 24 and October 30 at an average price of $80,526 per BTC, including fees and expenses, according to a Monday filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission.
The latest acquisition brings Strive closer to its year-end target of overtaking Japanese investment firm Metaplanet, which held approximately 44,000 BTC at the time of publication.
Strive would need another 876 BTC to pass that mark, assuming Metaplanet makes no further purchases.
Twenty One (NYSE: $XXI) holds 43,514 BTC, placing it ahead of Strive, while mining company MARA (NASDAQ: $MARA) holds 35,577 BTC, according to Bitcoin Treasuries data.
Strive's latest purchase marks a slower pace of accumulation following a busy October, when the company acquired around $1.25 billion worth of Bitcoin.

Strive CEO Matt Cole said the company funded most of its latest Bitcoin purchases using existing cash, while also tapping its $1 billion SATS preferred stock at-the-market offering for the first time.
The company launched the offering on October 26, allowing it to sell up to $1 billion in SATS preferred shares to finance additional Bitcoin purchases and other corporate expenses.

itens.titulo: BC deve manter Selic em 13,75% em uma pausa após a reeleição de Lula
itens.descricao: BC deve manter Selic em 13,75% em uma pausa após a reeleição de Lula InfoMoney
trechos: Mesmo com a vitória de Lula, a maioria dos analistas esperava inicialmente um sexto corte consecutivo de 25 pontos-base quando a pesquisa foi aberta, em 28 de outubro, já que a intervenção do Tesouro acalmou as turbulências do mercado no início da semana.
O real brasileiro perdeu 9% e o índice de ações Bovespa caiu cerca de 19% na semana passada.
Apenas 15 economistas ainda esperavam um corte por parte do Comitê de Política Monetária do Banco Central, conhecido como Copom, nesta quarta-feira.
“Acho que vem um pouquinho de ‘forward guidance’”, afirmou ela.

‘(Haverá) mais esses dois cortes nesse ano porque a inflação tem ajudado e o mercado de trabalho também está dando sinal de estagnação”, disse Fernanda Lima, economista-chefe da Barra Peixe Investimentos.
No entanto, a mediana das previsões trimestrais da pesquisa apontou para um nível estável de 13,75%, pelo menos até o segundo trimestre de 2027, quando era esperado outro corte de 25 pontos-base.
Dos 32 participantes, oito previram uma redução de um quarto de ponto percentual em março.

“A recente onda de vendas de ativos brasileiros provavelmente levará o Copom a permanecer cauteloso e avaliar a evolução do mercado nas próximas semanas”, escreveram analistas da Oxford Economics em um relatório.
